title: PEPSI the high-resolution echelle spectrograph and polarimeter for the LBT
what_was_studied: Two-arm design, image slicers, polarimetry and calibration options
numerical_result: Three modes provide resolving powers of about 43000, 120000 and 270000 over 383 to 907 nm in three exposures
remaining_question: Fabry-Perot capability is not an achieved stellar-RV floor

title: PEPSI deep spectra of the Sun-as-a-star
what_was_studied: Daytime solar feed and high-resolution reference spectra
numerical_result: The work demonstrates very high resolution and signal-to-noise solar spectra
remaining_question: Solar atlases test line shapes but not night-time telescope-feed stability

title: SDS4PEPSI data reduction
what_was_studied: Bias and scattered-light subtraction, order definition, weighted extraction, wavelength calibration and continuum fitting
numerical_result: The documented pipeline uses robust estimators and a self-consistent continuum fit across extracted orders
remaining_question: Mode-dependent wavelength and continuum systematics still need external tests

title: LBTO instruments overview
what_was_studied: Facility description and current observing role
numerical_result: LBTO lists PEPSI with resolving powers of about 53000, 130000 and 250000 from its permanent focus stations
remaining_question: A dated RV-specific performance statement is not supplied
